zh: 『断曰∶黄节晚香，清节可贵，逝水回波，急流勇退。』最后这四个字，胡雪岩是懂得；而且这也正是内则老母、外则良友在一再劝他的。此刻不自觉地便仔细想了下去。螺蛳太太也常看他起数，但都不似此刻这么认真，而且是上了心事的模样，当然深感关切。『瑞香，去调一杯玫瑰薄荷露来，我解解酒。』说着，在胡雪岩对面坐了下来问道∶『你起的数，倒讲给我听听。』『今天起的这个数，我愈想愈有道理。』胡雪岩说∶『先说我一帆风顺，不过到时候要收篷。啥时候呢？「帆随湘转处」，灵就灵在这个「湘」字上，是指左大人；到左大人不当两江总督了，我就要「下坡骏马早收缰」了。』『还有呢？』
en: “Judgment: The yellow bloom gives its fragrance late; unsullied integrity is precious. Flowing water swirls back upon itself: have the courage to withdraw from the swift current.” Hu understood that final injunction perfectly. It was precisely what his mother at home and his good friends outside had repeatedly urged him to do. Without quite realizing it, he began to ponder it closely. Madam Luosi had often watched him cast a divination, but never with such seriousness or with anything weighing on his mind as it seemed to do now. Naturally, she was concerned. “Ruixiang, mix me a glass of rose-and-mint cordial to clear my head after the wine.” Seating herself opposite Hu, she asked, “Tell me about the reading you have had.” “The more I think about today’s reading, the more sense it makes,” Hu replied. “First it says I am sailing before a fair wind, but that when the time comes I must furl my sail. When? ‘Where the sail turns with the Xiang.’ The uncanny thing is that word Xiang. It means Lord Zuo. When Lord Zuo ceases to be Governor-General of Liangjiang, I must ‘rein in the gallant horse before it takes the downward slope.’” “And what else?”

zh: 『还有这两句，也说得极准∶』施为无不利，到处要周旋。「拿银子铺路，自然无往不利路路通了。『』还有呢？『『那就是「急流勇退。」』螺蛳太太点点头，喝了一大口玫瑰薄荷露说∶『我看只有「急流勇退」四个字说得最好。又是「下坡」又是「骏马」，你想收缰都收不住。』胡雪岩正要回答，只听外面人在报∶『古老爷回来了。』『瑞香，』螺蛳太太一面站起来，一面说∶『带人来开饭。』
en: “These two lines are remarkably accurate too: ‘Whatever you attempt will prosper, but everywhere you must handle others tactfully.’ Pave the way with silver and naturally every road opens before you.” “And what else?” “‘Have the courage to withdraw from the swift current.’” Madam Luosi nodded and took a long drink of her rose-and-mint cordial. “I think that last advice is the best of all. A gallant horse, and a downward slope as well—by then, even if you wanted to pull on the reins, you might not be able to hold it back.” Hu was about to answer when someone announced from outside, “Mr Gu is back.” Madam Luosi rose. “Ruixiang, bring the servants in to lay dinner.”

zh: 『讲妥当了？』胡雪岩也站了起来，迎上去问。『讲好了。明天上午八点钟去看赫德。然后他料理公事完毕中午到灵隐去拜寿。『』吃饭呢？『螺蛳太太急忙问说。『这就要好好商量了。』『对，对，好好商量。』胡雪岩扬一扬手，『我们这面来谈。』古应春跟到书桌旁边坐定了说∶『我不但见了梅藤更，还见了赫德，他说他这一次一则来拜寿；二则还有事要跟小爷叔约谈。』『什么事？汇丰的款子，应付的本息还早啊！』『是茧子的事。』
en: “Is everything arranged?” Hu stood up too and went to meet him. “Yes. We shall call on Hart at eight tomorrow morning. Then, once he has finished his official business, he will come to Lingyin at noon to offer birthday greetings.” “And what about his meal?” Madam Luosi asked at once. “We must discuss that carefully.” “Yes, yes, let us do so.” Hu waved a hand. “Come over here.” Gu followed him to the desk and sat down. “I saw not only Dr Meitenggeng but Hart himself. He says he has come partly to offer birthday greetings and partly because there is something he wishes to discuss with you, Uncle.” “What is it? The principal and interest due to HSBC will not fall due for some time yet.” “It concerns the cocoons.”

zh: 『这个，』胡雪岩问∶『怡和的大板怎么不来呢？』『已经来了，也住在梅藤更那里。』『这样说，是有备而来的。我们倒要好好儿想个应付的办法。』『当然。』古应春又说∶『小爷叔，你哪天有空？』『要说空，哪一天都不空。』胡雪岩答说∶『他老远从北京到这里，当然主随客便，我们只有看他的意思。』『既然小爷叔这么说，明天中午等他到灵隐拜了生日，请他到府上来吃饭，顺便带他逛逛园子。』『我也是这么想。』胡雪岩问∶『吃西餐，还是中国菜。』『还是西餐吧。』古应春说∶『我这回带来的六个厨子，其中有一个是法皇的御厨，做出来的东西，不会坍台的。』『来，来！』螺蛳太太喊道∶『来坐吧！』
en: “In that case,” Hu asked, “why has Jardine Matheson’s chief manager not come?” “He has. He is staying with Dr Meitenggeng too.” “Then they have come prepared. We had better think carefully about how to deal with them.” “Certainly,” Gu said. “What day would suit you, Uncle?” “If you mean a day when I have nothing to do, none would. But he has come all the way from Beijing. The host must accommodate the guest; we can only see what suits him.” “Since you feel that way, why not invite him to dine at your house tomorrow after he has offered birthday greetings at Lingyin at noon? You could show him the garden as well.” “That is what I had in mind. Shall we serve Western food or Chinese?” “Western food, I think. Of the six cooks I have brought this time, one formerly cooked for the Emperor of the French. His food will not disgrace us.” “Come, come!” Madam Luosi called. “Sit down!”

zh: 『来了！』胡雪岩走过来说道∶『明天中午总税务司赫德要来吃饭，吃西餐；厨子应春带来，席摆在哪里方便，要预备点啥，顶好趁早交代下去。』『有多少人？』『主客一共四位。』古应春答说。『应春，』胡雪岩问∶『你是说，怡和的大班也请？』一听这语气，古应春便即反问∶『小爷叔的意思呢？』『我看「阳春面加重，免免」了！』『我看预备还是要预备在那里，』螺蛳太太插进来说∶『说不定赫德倒带了他来呢？』洋人没有挟带不速之客的习惯。螺蛳太太对这方面的应酬规矩不算内行；不过多预备总不错，或许临时想起还有什么人该请，即不致于捉襟见肘。因此，胡雪岩点点头说∶『对，多预备几份好了。』说着，相将落座，喝的是红葡萄酒；古应春看着斟在水晶杯中、紫光泛彩的酒说∶『这酒要冰了，味道才出得来。』『那就拿冰来冰。』原来胡家也跟大内一样，自己有冰窖。数九寒天，将热水倒在物制的方形木盒中，等表里晶莹，冻结实了，置于掘得极深、下铺草荐的地窖，到来年六月，方始开窖取用。此时胡雪岩交代，当然提前开窖。
en: “Coming!” Hu walked over. “Inspector-General Hart will be dining here tomorrow at noon. Western food. Yingchun will provide the cook. Where it would be convenient to set the table and what else will be needed had best be settled early.” “How many people?” “Four altogether, including hosts and guests,” Gu replied. “Yingchun, do you mean to invite Jardine Matheson’s chief manager too?” At the sound of Hu’s voice, Gu immediately asked in return, “What would you prefer, Uncle?” “I think we shall have ‘a double helping of plain noodles’—mian, mian: let us leave him out!” “I think we should prepare for him anyway,” Madam Luosi put in. “Hart might bring him along.” Foreigners were not in the habit of arriving with uninvited companions. Madam Luosi did not fully understand their rules of social intercourse. Still, it could do no harm to prepare extra. They might suddenly think of someone else who ought to be invited, and then they would not be caught short. Hu nodded. “Quite right. Have a few extra places ready.” They sat down together. Red wine was served. Looking at the purple glow of the wine in the crystal glasses, Gu said, “This wine needs chilling to bring out its flavor.” “Then bring some ice and chill it.” Like the imperial palace, the Hu household had its own ice cellar. In the depths of winter, hot water was poured into specially made square wooden molds. Once it had frozen solid, clear through and through, the blocks were laid in a very deep cellar with straw matting underneath. Ordinarily, it would not be opened until the sixth month of the following year. Hu’s order meant opening it ahead of time.

zh: 这一来不免大费手脚，耽误工夫，古应春颇为不安，但已知胡雪岩的脾气愈来愈任性，劝阴无用，只好听其自然。趁这工夫，胡雪岩与古应春将次日与赫德会谈可能涉及的各方面，细细研究了一番。其时螺蛳太太已回到前面，等席散送客；镜槛阁中，凿冰冻酒，检点肴馔，都是瑞香主持，只见她来往俏影，翩翩如蝶，不时吸引着古应春的视线移转。
en: This required considerable trouble and caused a delay, which made Gu uneasy. But he knew Hu was growing more willful by the day. Remonstrance would be useless, so he could only let matters take their course. They used the interval to examine in detail all the questions that might arise in the next day’s discussion with Hart. Madam Luosi had meanwhile gone back to the front of the house to wait for the banquet to end and see the guests off. At Jingjian Pavilion, Ruixiang supervised the breaking of the ice, the chilling of the wine, and the checking of the dishes. Her graceful figure flitted to and fro like a butterfly, repeatedly drawing Gu’s eyes after her.

zh: 胡雪岩看在眼里，愈发觉得刚才胸中所动的一念，应该从速实现。等入了座，他先看一看桌上的菜，问道∶『还有啥？』『还有锦乡长寿面、八仙上寿汤。』瑞香答说∶『古老爷跟老爷还想吃点啥？我去交代。』『够了，够了。』古应春说∶『两个人吃八样菜，已经多了；再多，反而看饱了吃不下。』『什么叫八仙上寿汤？』『就是八珍汤。』瑞香笑道∶『今天是老太太的好日子，所以我拿它改个名字。』『好，晓得了。』胡雪岩答说∶『我想吃点甜的，你到小厨房去看看，等弄好了带回来。』这是胡雪岩故意遣开瑞香，因为他要跟古应春说的话，是一时不便让瑞香知道睥。
en: Hu noticed. All the more reason, he thought, to put into effect without delay the idea that had occurred to him earlier. Once seated, he surveyed the dishes on the table. “What else is there?” “Splendid Longevity Noodles and Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup,” Ruixiang replied. “Would you or Mr Gu like anything else? I shall tell the kitchen.” “Enough, enough,” Gu said. “Eight dishes for two people are more than sufficient. Any more and we should be full just from looking.” “What is Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup?” Hu asked. “Eight Delicacies Soup,” Ruixiang answered with a smile. “I gave it a different name because this is the old lady’s happy day.” “Good. I see. I should like something sweet. Go to the small kitchen and see what they have. Bring it back when it is ready.” Hu was deliberately sending Ruixiang away. What he wanted to discuss with Gu could not yet be allowed to reach her ears.

zh: 『老太太说，这回生日样样都好，美中不足的，就是七姐没有来。』『要美中不足才好。』古应春答说∶『曾文正分别号叫「求阙斋」，特为去求美中不足，那才是持盈保仄之道。醇亲王从儿子做了皇帝以后，置了一样古董，叫做「欹器」，盛水不能满，一满就翻倒了。』胡雪岩并未听出他话中的深意，管自己问道∶『七姐现在身子怎么样？』『无非带病延年。西医说∶中风调养比吃药重要；调养第一要心兀，她就是心静不下来，我怎么劝也没用。』『为啥呢？』胡雪岩问∶『为啥心静不下来？』『小爷叔，你晓得她的，凡事好强。自从她病倒以后，家里当然不比从前那样子有条理了，她看不惯，自己要指挥，话又说不清楚，丫头老妈子弄来总不如她的意。你想，一个病人一天到晚操心，还要生气，糟糕不糟糕？』说到这里，古应春叹口气，将酒杯放了下来。
en: “The old lady says everything about her birthday is wonderful this year. The one thing lacking is that Sister Seven has not come.” “It is better to have something lacking,” Gu replied. “Zeng Guofan called his study ‘Seeking Imperfection.’ He deliberately sought a flaw in perfection; that is the way to preserve prosperity and keep oneself safe. After his son became emperor, Prince Chun acquired an antique vessel called a tilting bowl. You cannot fill it right up: when it is full, it overturns.” Hu missed the deeper meaning of his words and pursued his own question. “How is Sister Seven’s health now?” “She can only nurse her illness and hope to live on. The Western doctor says that after a stroke, proper care matters more than medicine. The first requirement is peace of mind, but she simply cannot be at peace. Nothing I say will persuade her.” “Why?” Hu asked. “Why can she not settle her mind?” “You know her, Uncle. She insists on doing everything well. Since she fell ill, the house has naturally not been as orderly as before. She cannot bear to see it and wants to direct things herself, but she cannot speak clearly, and whatever the maids and older servants do never satisfies her. Think of it: a sick woman worrying all day and getting angry into the bargain. Is that not dreadful?” Gu sighed and set down his glass.

zh: 提起不愉快的事，害得他败了酒兴，胡雪岩不免歉然，但正因为如此，更要往深处去谈。『还有呢？』『还有，就是她总不放心我；常说她对不起，因为她病在床上，没法子照料我的饮食起居。我说，你千万不要这样想，这是没法子的事；再说，有丫头老妈子，我自己会指挥。她说∶没有体己的人，到底不一样。又说∶』中年丧妻大不幸，弄个半死不活的老婆在那里，你反而要为我操心，是加倍的大不幸。「常时谈得她也哭，我也哭。『说着，古应春又泫然欲涕了。『应春，你说得我也想哭了。你们真正是所谓伉俪情深，来世也一定是恩爱夫妻。不过，既然七姐是这样子的情形，我的想法倒又改过了。』『小爷叔，你有啥想法？』
en: Hu felt sorry to have raised an unhappy subject and spoiled his friend’s pleasure in the wine. Yet this was precisely why he had to pursue it. “And what else?” “She is always worrying about me. She often says she has failed me because she is confined to bed and cannot look after my meals and daily needs. I tell her she must not think like that: it cannot be helped, and besides, there are maids and older servants whom I can direct myself. She says that without someone close to me it is simply not the same. Then she says, ‘To lose your wife in middle age is a great misfortune. To have a wife who is neither quite alive nor dead, and to have to worry about her as well, is twice the misfortune.’ Often we talk until she is crying and I am crying too.” As he spoke, Gu was again close to tears. “Yingchun, you make me want to cry myself,” Hu said. “Yours truly is a marriage of deep affection. I am sure you will be a loving couple in the next life as well. Still, if that is how things stand with Sister Seven, it changes my thinking.” “What have you been thinking, Uncle?”

zh: 『我在想，要替你弄个人。这个人当然要你中意，要七姐也中意。人，我已经有了，虽说有把握，你们都会中意，不过，女人家的事情，有时候是很难说的，尤其是讨小纳妾，更加要慎重，所以我想过些日子，叫罗四姐到上海去一趟，当面跟七姐商量，照现在看，我想这件事，可以定局了。』一番话说得古应春心乱如麻，不知是喜是惧？定定神，理出一个头绪，先要知道，胡雪岩心目中，『已经有了』的那个人是谁？等他一问出来，胡雪岩答道∶『还有哪个，自然是瑞香。』古应春又惊又喜，眼前浮起瑞香的影子，耳边响起瑞香的声音，顿时生出无限的遐想。『应春，』胡雪岩问说∶『你看怎么样，七姐会不会中意她？』『我想，应该会。』
en: “I have been thinking of finding someone for you. Naturally, she must be someone you like and Sister Seven likes too. I already have someone in mind. Though I am confident you would both be pleased with her, matters involving women are sometimes difficult to judge, and taking a concubine calls for even greater care. I had therefore thought of sending Sister Luo to Shanghai in a few days to discuss it with Sister Seven in person. From what you have told me, however, I think we may be able to settle it.” Gu’s thoughts were in turmoil. He hardly knew whether he was pleased or afraid. Composing himself, he picked out the first question to be answered: who was the woman Hu already had in mind? When he asked, Hu replied, “Who else? Ruixiang, of course.” Gu was startled and delighted. Her figure rose before his eyes and her voice sounded in his ears, setting his imagination wandering. “Yingchun,” Hu asked, “what do you think? Would Sister Seven be pleased with her?” “I think she ought to be.”

zh: 『你呢？』古应春笑笑不答，只顾自己从冰桶中取酒瓶来斟酒。『我说得不错吧！这个人你们夫妻俩都会中意。』『话也不能这么说。』古应春将七姑奶奶得病以来说过的话，细细搜索了一遍，有些悲伤地说∶『小爷叔，有件事，我不能不提出来。阿七从来没有提过要替我弄一个人的话。』这使得胡雪岩一楞，心中寻思，七姑奶奶既然因为无法亲自照料丈夫的饮食起居而深感抱歉；同时也觉得没有一个得力的帮手替她治家，那末以她一向看得广、想得深的性情，一定会转过替古应春提过，这中间就大可玩味了。
en: “And you?” Gu smiled without answering and busied himself taking the wine bottle from the ice bucket to refill his glass. “Was I not right? Both husband and wife would be pleased with her.” “One cannot quite put it that way.” Gu searched his memory for everything the Seventh Lady had said since falling ill. With some sadness he continued, “Uncle, there is something I cannot leave unmentioned. A’qi has never once suggested finding someone for me.” That gave Hu pause. The Seventh Lady felt deeply sorry that she could no longer personally care for her husband’s meals and daily needs; at the same time, she plainly lacked a capable assistant to manage the household. Given her habitual breadth of view and depth of thought, she must surely have considered finding someone for Gu. Yet she had never raised the subject. There was much to ponder in that.

zh: 『应春，』他问∶『你自己有没有讨小的打算？』古应春仔仔细细地回忆着，而且在重新体认自己曾经有过的感想以后，很慎重地答说∶『如果说没有，我是说假话。不过，这种念头只要一起，我马我会丢掉，自己告诉自己∶不要自讨苦吃。』『这种心境，你同七姐谈过没有？』『没有。』『从来没有谈过？』『从没有。』『有没有露过这样的口风呢？』见他这样『打破沙锅问到底』，古应春倒不敢信口回答了，复又想了一下，方始开口∶『没有。』
en: “Yingchun,” he asked, “have you yourself thought of taking a concubine?” Gu searched his memory carefully and reconsidered feelings he had once had. At last he answered with great seriousness. “I should be lying if I said no. But whenever the thought arises, I immediately dismiss it. I tell myself not to go looking for trouble.” “Have you ever discussed these feelings with Sister Seven?” “No.” “Never?” “Never.” “Have you ever even hinted at them?” Hu’s insistence on getting to the bottom of the matter made Gu unwilling to answer casually. He thought again before saying, “No.”

zh: 『好！我懂了。』胡雪岩说∶『讨小讨得不好，是自讨若吃；讨得好，另当别论。我料七姐的心事，不是不想替你弄个人，是这个人不容易去觅。又要能干，又要体贴，又要肯听她的话；还要相貌看得过去，所以心里虽有这样的念头，没有觅着中意的人之前，先不开口。七姐做事向来是这样的，我晓得。』古应春觉得他的话也不无道理，倒不防探探妻子的口气。旋即转念，此事决不能轻发！倘若妻子根本不愿，一说这话，岂非伤了感情？『能干、体贴、听话、相貌过得去，这四个条件，顶要紧的是听话。七姐人情、世故熟透，世界上总是听话的老实无用；能干调皮捣蛋，她一个端正人，躺在床上，如果叫人到东，偏要到西，拿她有啥法子？那一来，不是把她活活气死？七姐顾虑来，顾虑去，就是顾虑这个。应春，你说对不对！』『是的。』古应春不能不承认∶『小爷叔把职七的为人，看得很透。』『闲话少说，我们来谈瑞香。四个条件，她占了三个；体贴或许差一点，不过那也是将来你们感情上的事，感情深了，自然会体贴。』『哪里就谈得到将来了？』古应春笑着喝了口酒说∶『这件事要慢慢商量。』
en: “Good. I understand,” Hu said. “A badly chosen concubine does indeed mean looking for trouble. A well-chosen one is another matter. I suspect Sister Seven is not opposed to finding you someone; the difficulty is finding the right person. She must be capable and considerate, willing to obey her, and reasonably good-looking as well. So although the idea is in her mind, she will say nothing until she has found someone suitable. That is how Sister Seven has always done things. I know her.” Gu thought there was some reason in his words. Perhaps he might sound his wife out. But immediately he checked himself. This was not a subject to raise lightly. If she was fundamentally unwilling, would mentioning it not wound her feelings? Hu went on, “Capable, considerate, obedient, and reasonably good-looking: of those four conditions, obedience matters most. Sister Seven knows human nature and the ways of the world thoroughly. Obedient people tend to be honest but useless; capable ones tend to be unruly and mischievous. She is an upright woman, lying there in bed. If she tells someone to go east and that person insists on going west, what can she do? It would anger her to death. That is the worry she turns over and over in her mind. Is that not so, Yingchun?” “Yes,” Gu had to admit. “You understand A’qi very well, Uncle.” “Enough talk. Let us consider Ruixiang. She meets three of the four conditions. Perhaps she falls a little short in consideration, but that will depend on your feelings for each other later. Once the affection is deep, consideration will come naturally.” “How can we already be talking about later?” Gu laughed and took a sip of wine. “This matter needs careful discussion.”

zh: 『你说谈不到将来，我说喜事就在眼前。』胡雪岩略略放低了声音∶『贤慧，瑞香当然还谈不到；不过，我同罗四姐两个人一起替你写包票，一定听七姐的话。你信不信。』古应春何能不信，亦何能不喜，但总顾虑着妻子如果真的有妨意，这件事就弄巧成拙了。看他脸上忽喜忽忧的神情，胡雪岩当然也能约略猜到他的心事。但夫妻之间的这种情形，到底只有同床共枕的人才能判断。所以他不再固劝，让它冷一冷，看古应春多想一想以后的态度，再作道理。
en: “You say we cannot talk about later; I say the happy occasion is just before us.” Hu lowered his voice a little. “I cannot yet call Ruixiang a model of womanly virtue. But Sister Luo and I will jointly guarantee that she obeys Sister Seven. Do you believe us?” How could Gu fail to believe him, or fail to be delighted? Yet he still feared that if his wife truly resented the idea, their clever plan might produce the opposite of what they intended. Hu could readily guess his thoughts from the way delight and anxiety alternated on his face. Still, only those who shared a bed could really judge such matters between husband and wife. He pressed no further, allowing the subject to cool. He would see what attitude Gu took after more thought and decide what to do then.

zh: 于是把话题扯了开去，海阔天空地聊了一阵，瑞香亲自提来一个细篾金漆圆笼，打开来看，青花瓷盘中，盛着现做的枣泥核花奶酥；是醇亲王厨子传授的。接着，小厨房另外送来寿面跟『八仙上寿汤』；寿面一大盘，炒得十分出色，但胡雪岩与古应春都是应应景，浅尝即止。『多吃点嘛！』瑞香劝道∶『这么好的寿面，不吃真可惜。』『说得不错。』古应春答说∶『我再来一点。』
en: He changed the subject, and they chatted freely for a while. Ruixiang herself brought in a round basket of finely woven bamboo coated with gold lacquer. Inside, on a blue-and-white porcelain plate, lay freshly made cream pastries filled with date paste and walnuts, made from a recipe passed on by Prince Chun’s cook. The small kitchen next sent in the birthday noodles and the Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup. There was a great platter of beautifully fried noodles, but both Hu and Gu merely tasted a little for the occasion. “Do have some more,” Ruixiang urged. “Such fine birthday noodles—it would be a pity not to eat them.” “You are right,” Gu replied. “I shall have a little more.”

zh: 于是好替他们各自盛了一小碗，古应春努力加餐，算是吃完了。胡雪尝了一口说道∶『我再来一点。』『糟蹋了实在可惜。』瑞香向外喊道，『小梅，你们把这盘寿面拿去，分了吃掉∶沾沾老太太的福气。』说着，亲自将一盘炒面捧了出去。胡雪岩看在眼里，暗自点头。等饭罢茶时，螺蛳太太亦已客散稍闲，来到镜槛阁休息；当然还有许多杂条要料理，走马换将，都交给瑞香了。
en: She filled a small bowl for each of them. Gu made an effort and finished his. Hu tasted a mouthful and said, “I shall have a little more.” “It would be a shame to let them go to waste.” Ruixiang called outside. “Xiaomei, take this platter of birthday noodles and share it among you. Have a little of the old lady’s good fortune!” She carried the platter out herself. Hu watched and nodded inwardly. When they had finished eating and were drinking tea, Madam Luosi came to Jingjian Pavilion to rest, her guests now departed. There were, of course, still many miscellaneous matters to attend to. The two women exchanged duties, leaving everything to Ruixiang.

zh: 『我刚刚跟应春谈了一件大事，现在要同你商量了。』商量的便是嫁瑞香之事；不等胡雪岩话毕，螺蛳太太便即说道∶『我早就有这个意思了。七姐夫，史要七姐一句话，我马上来办。』『就是这句话为难。』古应春答说∶『我自己当然不便提；就是旁人去提，也不大妥当。』『何以见得？』『人家去说，她表面上说不出不愿意的话来，心里有了疙瘩，对她的病，大不相宜。』
en: “I have just been discussing an important matter with Yingchun. Now I must consult you.” It was the proposed marriage of Ruixiang. Before Hu had finished, Madam Luosi said, “I have long had the same idea. Brother-in-law Gu, let Sister Seven say the word, and I shall arrange it at once.” “That one word is precisely the difficulty,” Gu replied. “I can hardly raise the subject myself, and it would not be quite proper even for someone else to do so.” “Why not?” “If someone speaks to her, she will be unable to say openly that she objects. But she may harbor a grievance in her heart, which would be very bad for her health.”

zh: 『我看七姐不会的。』胡雪岩对螺蛳太太说∶『下个月我到上海，你同我一起去，当面跟七姐谈这件事。』『那一来，她怎么样不愿意，也得很高兴。』古应春大为摇头∶『不妥，不妥！她决不肯说真心话的。』『我倒有个办法，我要由七姐自己开口。』此言一出，古应春、胡雪岩一齐倾身注目，倒要听听她是何好办法，能使得七姑奶奶自愿为丈夫纳妾。『办法很容易。』螺蛳太太说∶『我把瑞香带了去。只说我不放心她的病，特为叫瑞香去服侍她，帮她理家的。只要瑞香服侍得好，事事听她的话，她自然会想到，要留住瑞香只有一条路，让她也姓古。』『此计大妙！』岩胡雪拍着手说∶『准定这么办。』
en: “I do not think Sister Seven would,” Hu said. He turned to Madam Luosi. “Come with me when I go to Shanghai next month and discuss it with her face to face.” Gu shook his head vigorously. “Then, however unwilling she was, she would have to pretend to be delighted. No, no. She would never tell you her true feelings.” “I have a way,” Madam Luosi said. “I shall have Sister Seven herself bring it up.” At this, both men leaned forward and fixed their eyes on her, eager to hear how she could induce the Seventh Lady voluntarily to arrange a concubine for her husband. “It is quite simple. I shall take Ruixiang along. I shall merely say that I am worried about her illness and have brought Ruixiang specially to wait on her and help her manage the house. Provided Ruixiang serves her well and obeys her in everything, she will naturally see that there is only one way to keep her: let her become a member of the Gu family.” “A marvelous plan!” Hu clapped his hands. “That is settled, then.”

zh: 古应春也觉得这是个很妥当的办法，但螺蛳太太却提出了警告∶『七姐夫，不过我劝你不要心急，你最好先疏远瑞香一点。』『人逢喜事精神爽』古应春这一夜只睡了两个辰，一觉醒来，天还没有亮透，看自鸣钟上一直线，恰好六点钟响。他住的是胡家花园中的一处客房，名叫锁春院，茶木甚盛，揭开重帘，推出窗去，花香鸟语，令人精神一振，心里寻思，这天洋人拜寿，是他的『重头戏』，宁可赶早去巡查，看有什么不妥的地方，须先改正，庶几不负至交所托。于是漱洗早餐，随即带了跟班，坐着胡家替他预备的轿子，先巡视了设在城里的六处寿堂，一一检点妥当，然后出钱塘门到灵隐，不过九点刚过。这灵隐的寿堂，原规定了是英国人来拜寿的地方，只是洋人闹不清这些细节，有的逛了天竺、灵隐，顺便就来拜寿，人数不多，倒是看的人多，指指点点，嘻嘻哈哈，乱得很热闹。
en: Gu, too, thought it a very sound plan. Madam Luosi added a warning, however. “Brother-in-law Gu, do not be impatient. You had better keep your distance from Ruixiang at first.” Happiness renews a man’s spirits. Gu slept only four hours that night, and when he woke, it was not yet fully light. Looking at the clock, he saw the hands in a straight line just as it struck six. He was staying in a guest suite in Hu’s garden called Suochun Court, where flowers and trees grew thickly. He lifted the heavy curtains and pushed open the window. Fragrant blossoms and birdsong refreshed his spirits. Today’s reception for the foreign birthday visitors would be his great undertaking. He had better begin his inspections early, discover and correct anything amiss, and justify the trust his close friend had placed in him. He washed, ate breakfast, and set out with an attendant in the sedan the Hu household had provided. First he inspected the six birthday halls inside the city and checked that all was in order. Then he went out through Qiantang Gate to Lingyin. It was only just after nine when he arrived. The Lingyin hall had originally been assigned to the British visitors, but foreigners did not understand these fine distinctions. Some simply called to offer their congratulations after sightseeing at Tianzhu and Lingyin. There were not many guests, but a great many spectators, pointing, chattering, and laughing in lively disorder.
